name: Mahatma Gandhi
note: assetkit-models-sf/gandhi: OSM way/174999601, on the Ferry Plaza deck (sea + 3.5). 2.4 m (8 ft) bronze on a block with its plaque, raised on two steps (Wikipedia; Commons photo: a long low block, wider than deep).

name: Willie Mays
note: assetkit-models-sf/willie-mays: OSM node 4908344426, Willie Mays Plaza, facing 3rd and King.

name: Abraham Lincoln
note: assetkit-models-sf/lincoln-city-hall: OSM node 1901905716, City Hall's Polk Street side, facing east; bronze on a pale granite die (owner's photo, 2026-10-18).

name: Dewey Monument (capital and Victory)
note: assetkit-models-sf/dewey-monument-pbr (the PBR variant: darker verdigris, closer to the real near-black): the capital, drum, globe and Victory on the shaft's plain top, sunk 0.15 m into it so no seam shows (owner, 2026-10-18). The model's neck is 1.5 m across, the shaft's top (union-square.ts r 0.75).

name: Admission Day Monument miner
note: assetkit-models-sf/admission-day-miner: OSM node 386573810 (Market, Post and Montgomery). The real monument is Tilden's granite column with the winged figure on top and this bronze miner with his flag at its foot, so the procedural column stays and the miner stands 3.6 m in front of it, facing down Market (bearing 50, from the site).

name: The Cider Press
note: assetkit-models-sf/cider-press: OSM way 1454996308 (tourism=artwork), Music Concourse, Golden Gate Park. Bearing 270 is a guess toward the Concourse; 2.5 m (about.md).

name: Andrea fountain mermaids
note: assetkit-models-sf/asawa-mermaid-fountain: the mermaids on the central plinth of the procedural basin (art.ts asawaMermaidFountain, which was built for them), moved to OSM way 939539789, the pool on Ghirardelli Square's terrace.

name: Ashurbanipal
note: assetkit-models-sf/ashurbanipal: OSM node 6465902729, Fulton Street by the Main Library, facing south across Fulton to the library (Parhad's Wikipedia entry); 2.5 m on a 2.0 m pedestal.

name: Beethoven bust
note: assetkit-models-sf/beethoven-bust: OSM way 1210652265, SE side of the Music Concourse, Golden Gate Park, facing northwest into it (a guess).

name: Benjamin Franklin
note: assetkit-models-sf/franklin-washington-square: OSM node 434700934, Washington Square, facing south toward the church (a guess); 2.4 m on a ~3.4 m pedestal.

name: Bufano St. Francis
note: assetkit-models-sf/bufano-st-francis: SE corner of Taylor and Beach, Frank Cresci Plaza (OSM way 817970857, 24 x 35 m; the exact spot within it is a guess). 18 ft (5.5 m); faces northwest, since the front photo looks southeast to Coit Tower and the Pyramid.

name: Bufano Penguins
note: assetkit-models-sf/bufano-penguins: OSM node 8722065772 'The Penguins', Gateway Commons plaza by Ironship Plaza; faces west toward Davis Court (a guess); ~1.8 m with its base.

name: General Pershing
note: assetkit-models-sf/pershing-golden-gate-park: OSM node 3297579562, east side of the Music Concourse, facing west into it (a guess); ~2.6 m bronze on a ~3.2 m granite pedestal.

name: Dragon Gate guardian lion (west)
note: assetkit-models-sf/chinatown-guardian-lion: Dragon Gate (OSM node 65328703, procedural gate front 171), 7 m west of Grant's centreline and 3 m south of the gate, turned 15 deg inward toward the street.

name: Dragon Gate guardian lion (east)
note: assetkit-models-sf/chinatown-guardian-lion: Dragon Gate (OSM node 65328703, procedural gate front 171), 7 m east of Grant's centreline and 3 m south of the gate, mirror of the west lion.

name: Goddess of Democracy
note: assetkit-models-sf/goddess-of-democracy-portsmouth: OSM node 7177796746, Portsmouth Square, facing west toward Chinatown (a guess); ~3 m bronze on a pale granite block (~0.9 m).

name: Joseph Strauss
note: assetkit-models-sf/joseph-strauss: OSM node 6467168692 (Joseph Strauss Legacy Circle), at the Golden Gate Bridge's south end, facing away from the bridge, south-east (from the Commons photo, bridge tower behind his right); ~2.5 m bronze, the low round disc under him is not drawn.

name: The Lone Sailor
note: assetkit-models-sf/lone-sailor-vista-point: OSM node 669137728, Vista Point on the bridge's NORTH (Marin) side, facing south-south-east toward the bridge and bay (Commons photos: Marin hills behind him); ~2.5 m with its red granite base.

name: Lotta's Fountain
note: assetkit-models-sf/lottas-fountain: OSM node 358803316, Market at Kearny and Geary; the whole ~7.3 m cast-iron column replaces the procedural lottasFountain; four-sided, bearing arbitrary.

name: Miguel Hidalgo
note: assetkit-models-sf/miguel-hidalgo: OSM node 5566754390, the upper (19th Street) corner of Dolores Park, facing south into the park (a guess); ~3 m bronze on a black granite die ~2.6 m (Commons photo).

name: Pioneer Mother
note: assetkit-models-sf/pioneer-mother: OSM node 5135797823, Golden Gate Park meadow, facing south toward the path (a guess); ~3 m bronze on the red-brown stone base (the model brings the small bronze step above it).

name: Puddle Jumpers
note: assetkit-models-sf/puddle-jumpers: Transamerica Redwood Park (37.7951,-122.4027); the procedural pool (art.ts redwoodParkBronzes, built for these figures) stays and the chain of five stands beside it on its puddle discs, running toward the south-east (a guess).

name: Seals Plaza seal
note: assetkit-models-sf/lou-seal-plaza: OSM node 1137861906 (Marina Gate), Seals Plaza outside Oracle Park's water-side gate; the seal balancing a ball (Alfredo Osorio, 1996), placed ~10 m from the gate, facing away from the park (a guess). The file is called Lou Seal.

name: Pier 39 crab topiary
note: assetkit-models-sf/pier39-crab-topiary: OSM node 5455625122 (artwork, '"Crab Topiary" Crab Statue'), facing south (a guess); ~2.5 m (a guess).

name: Guardians of the Gate

name: Presidio Spanish cannon (west)

name: Presidio Spanish cannon (east)
note: assetkit-models-sf/presidio-spanish-cannon: Pershing Square, Main Post (OSM node 12441100101); 2.5 m east of the node, the other of the pair either side of the flagpole, muzzle east (direction a guess).
